+import json
+from pathlib import Path
+
+import duckdb
+import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
+import pandas as pd
+
+
+ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parent
+OUT = ROOT / "out"
+OUT.mkdir(exist_ok=True)
+source = str(ROOT / "data" / "crashes.parquet")
+
+annual = duckdb.connect().execute(
+    """
+    SELECT year(crash_date) AS year,
+           count(*) AS crashes,
+           sum(number_of_motorist_killed) AS motorist_deaths,
+           count(*) FILTER (WHERE number_of_motorist_killed > 0) AS crashes_with_motorist_death
+    FROM read_parquet(?)
+    WHERE crash_date >= DATE '2013-01-01' AND crash_date < DATE '2026-01-01'
+    GROUP BY year
+    ORDER BY year
+    """,
+    [source],
+).df()
+annual["deaths_per_1000_crashes"] = annual["motorist_deaths"] / annual["crashes"] * 1000
+annual["pct_crashes_with_motorist_death"] = (
+    annual["crashes_with_motorist_death"] / annual["crashes"] * 100
+)
+
+coverage = duckdb.connect().execute(
+    """
+    SELECT year(crash_date) AS year, count(*) AS rows,
+           count(*) FILTER (WHERE crash_date IS NULL OR number_of_motorist_killed IS NULL) AS unusable
+    FROM read_parquet(?)
+    GROUP BY year ORDER BY year
+    """,
+    [source],
+).df()
+total_rows = int(coverage["rows"].sum())
+excluded_years = coverage[~coverage["year"].between(2013, 2025)]
+
+v1 = annual[["year", "motorist_deaths"]].copy()
+v1.to_csv(OUT / "values_1.csv", index=False)
+
+plt.figure(figsize=(10, 5.8))
+plt.bar(v1["year"], v1["motorist_deaths"], color="#326891", width=0.72)
+plt.xticks(v1["year"], rotation=45)
+plt.ylabel("Motorist deaths (count)")
+plt.xlabel("Crash year")
+plt.title("Motorist deaths in NYC reported crashes, 2013–2025")
+plt.grid(axis="y", alpha=0.25)
+plt.tight_layout()
+plt.savefig(OUT / "option_1.png", dpi=180)
+plt.close()
+
+v2 = annual[["year", "crashes", "crashes_with_motorist_death", "pct_crashes_with_motorist_death"]].copy()
+v2.to_csv(OUT / "values_2.csv", index=False)
+
+plt.figure(figsize=(10, 5.8))
+plt.plot(
+    v2["year"], v2["pct_crashes_with_motorist_death"],
+    marker="o", linewidth=2, color="#b44832",
+)
+plt.xticks(v2["year"], rotation=45)
+plt.ylabel("Reported crashes with ≥1 motorist death (%)")
+plt.xlabel("Crash year")
+plt.title("Share of NYC reported crashes with a motorist death, 2013–2025")
+plt.grid(alpha=0.25)
+plt.tight_layout()
+plt.savefig(OUT / "option_2.png", dpi=180)
+plt.close()
+
+first, last = annual.iloc[0], annual.iloc[-1]
+death_change_pct = (last["motorist_deaths"] / first["motorist_deaths"] - 1) * 100
+share_change_pct = (
+    last["pct_crashes_with_motorist_death"]
+    / first["pct_crashes_with_motorist_death"] - 1
+) * 100
+
+excluded_detail = []
+for row in excluded_years.itertuples(index=False):
+    excluded_detail.append(
+        f"{int(row.rows):,} {int(row.year)} records (100% of that year's {int(row.rows):,} rows; "
+        f"{row.rows / total_rows * 100:.2f}% of the file)"
+    )
+excluded_text = " and ".join(excluded_detail)
+unusable_pct = int(coverage["unusable"].sum()) / total_rows * 100
+omission = (
+    f"It excludes {excluded_text} because those calendar years are partial; "
+    f"no rows are omitted for null crash dates or motorist-killed values ({unusable_pct:.2f}% of rows)."
+)
+
+options = {
+    "options": [
+        {
+            "id": 1,
+            "metric": "Annual count of motorist deaths in reported crashes",
+            "denominator": "None (absolute count)",
+            "grouping": "Calendar year of crash_date",
+            "chart_type": "Bar chart",
+            "reason": "A count directly shows the annual burden of motorist deaths recorded in the crash file.",
+            "probability": 0.55,
+            "answer": (
+                f"The file cannot show deaths per mile; recorded motorist deaths fell from "
+                f"{int(first.motorist_deaths)} in 2013 to {int(last.motorist_deaths)} in 2025 "
+                f"({abs(death_change_pct):.1f}% lower)."
+            ),
+            "interpretation": (
+                f"The chart answers how the annual number of recorded motorist deaths changed: "
+                f"it fell from {int(first.motorist_deaths)} in 2013 to {int(last.motorist_deaths)} in 2025. "
+                "An absolute death count is a direct measure of fatality burden in this crash file, although it is not an exposure-adjusted risk. "
+                f"It leaves deaths per mile unanswered because the file has no mileage measure; {omission}"
+            ),
+        },
+        {
+            "id": 2,
+            "metric": "Share of reported crashes with at least one motorist death",
+            "denominator": "All reported crashes in the same calendar year",
+            "grouping": "Calendar year of crash_date",
+            "chart_type": "Line chart",
+            "reason": "This crash-normalized measure distinguishes fatal-motorist crashes from changes in the total volume of reported crashes.",
+            "probability": 0.45,
+            "answer": (
+                f"The file cannot show deaths per mile; the share of reported crashes with a motorist death rose "
+                f"from {first.pct_crashes_with_motorist_death:.3f}% in 2013 to "
+                f"{last.pct_crashes_with_motorist_death:.3f}% in 2025 ({share_change_pct:.1f}% higher)."
+            ),
+            "interpretation": (
+                f"The chart answers whether motorist-fatal crashes became less common among reported crashes: the share rose from "
+                f"{first.pct_crashes_with_motorist_death:.3f}% in 2013 to {last.pct_crashes_with_motorist_death:.3f}% in 2025. "
+                "This is a defensible crash-based comparison because its denominator is all reported crashes in each year, but it is not a per-mile risk measure. "
+                f"It leaves deaths per mile unanswered because the file has no mileage measure; {omission}"
+            ),
+        },
+    ]
+}
+(OUT / "options.json").write_text(json.dumps(options, indent=2) + "\n")
+
+print(annual.to_string(index=False))
+print(f"\nTotal rows: {total_rows}; excluded years: {excluded_detail}; unusable rows: {int(coverage['unusable'].sum())}")
+print(f"Death count change: {death_change_pct:.6f}%; fatal-crash share change: {share_change_pct:.6f}%")
*** End Patch

import json
from pathlib import Path

import duckdb
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import pandas as pd


ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parent
OUT = ROOT / "out"
OUT.mkdir(exist_ok=True)
source = str(ROOT / "data" / "crashes.parquet")

annual = duckdb.connect().execute(
    """
    SELECT year(crash_date) AS year,
           count(*) AS crashes,
           sum(number_of_motorist_killed) AS motorist_deaths,
           count(*) FILTER (WHERE number_of_motorist_killed > 0) AS crashes_with_motorist_death
    FROM read_parquet(?)
    WHERE crash_date >= DATE '2013-01-01' AND crash_date < DATE '2026-01-01'
    GROUP BY year
    ORDER BY year
    """,
    [source],
).df()
annual["deaths_per_1000_crashes"] = annual["motorist_deaths"] / annual["crashes"] * 1000
annual["pct_crashes_with_motorist_death"] = (
    annual["crashes_with_motorist_death"] / annual["crashes"] * 100
)

coverage = duckdb.connect().execute(
    """
    SELECT year(crash_date) AS year, count(*) AS rows,
           count(*) FILTER (WHERE crash_date IS NULL OR number_of_motorist_killed IS NULL) AS unusable
    FROM read_parquet(?)
    GROUP BY year ORDER BY year
    """,
    [source],
).df()
total_rows = int(coverage["rows"].sum())
excluded_years = coverage[~coverage["year"].between(2013, 2025)]

v1 = annual[["year", "motorist_deaths"]].copy()
v1.to_csv(OUT / "values_1.csv", index=False)

plt.figure(figsize=(10, 5.8))
plt.bar(v1["year"], v1["motorist_deaths"], color="#326891", width=0.72)
plt.xticks(v1["year"], rotation=45)
plt.ylabel("Motorist deaths (count)")
plt.xlabel("Crash year")
plt.title("Motorist deaths in NYC reported crashes, 2013–2025")
plt.grid(axis="y", alpha=0.25)
plt.tight_layout()
plt.savefig(OUT / "option_1.png", dpi=180)
plt.close()

v2 = annual[["year", "crashes", "crashes_with_motorist_death", "pct_crashes_with_motorist_death"]].copy()
v2.to_csv(OUT / "values_2.csv", index=False)

plt.figure(figsize=(10, 5.8))
plt.plot(
    v2["year"], v2["pct_crashes_with_motorist_death"],
    marker="o", linewidth=2, color="#b44832",
)
plt.xticks(v2["year"], rotation=45)
plt.ylabel("Reported crashes with ≥1 motorist death (%)")
plt.xlabel("Crash year")
plt.title("Share of NYC reported crashes with a motorist death, 2013–2025")
plt.grid(alpha=0.25)
plt.tight_layout()
plt.savefig(OUT / "option_2.png", dpi=180)
plt.close()

first, last = annual.iloc[0], annual.iloc[-1]
death_change_pct = (last["motorist_deaths"] / first["motorist_deaths"] - 1) * 100
share_change_pct = (
    last["pct_crashes_with_motorist_death"]
    / first["pct_crashes_with_motorist_death"] - 1
) * 100

excluded_detail = []
for row in excluded_years.itertuples(index=False):
    excluded_detail.append(
        f"{int(row.rows):,} {int(row.year)} records (100% of that year's {int(row.rows):,} rows; "
        f"{row.rows / total_rows * 100:.2f}% of the file)"
    )
excluded_text = " and ".join(excluded_detail)
unusable_pct = int(coverage["unusable"].sum()) / total_rows * 100
omission = (
    f"It excludes {excluded_text} because those calendar years are partial; "
    f"no rows are omitted for null crash dates or motorist-killed values ({unusable_pct:.2f}% of rows)."
)

options = {
    "options": [
        {
            "id": 1,
            "metric": "Annual count of motorist deaths in reported crashes",
            "denominator": "None (absolute count)",
            "grouping": "Calendar year of crash_date",
            "chart_type": "Bar chart",
            "reason": "A count directly shows the annual burden of motorist deaths recorded in the crash file.",
            "probability": 0.55,
            "answer": (
                f"The file cannot show deaths per mile; recorded motorist deaths fell from "
                f"{int(first.motorist_deaths)} in 2013 to {int(last.motorist_deaths)} in 2025 "
                f"({abs(death_change_pct):.1f}% lower)."
            ),
            "interpretation": (
                f"The chart answers how the annual number of recorded motorist deaths changed: "
                f"it fell from {int(first.motorist_deaths)} in 2013 to {int(last.motorist_deaths)} in 2025. "
                "An absolute death count is a direct measure of fatality burden in this crash file, although it is not an exposure-adjusted risk. "
                f"It leaves deaths per mile unanswered because the file has no mileage measure; {omission}"
            ),
        },
        {
            "id": 2,
            "metric": "Share of reported crashes with at least one motorist death",
            "denominator": "All reported crashes in the same calendar year",
            "grouping": "Calendar year of crash_date",
            "chart_type": "Line chart",
            "reason": "This crash-normalized measure distinguishes fatal-motorist crashes from changes in the total volume of reported crashes.",
            "probability": 0.45,
            "answer": (
                f"The file cannot show deaths per mile; the share of reported crashes with a motorist death rose "
                f"from {first.pct_crashes_with_motorist_death:.3f}% in 2013 to "
                f"{last.pct_crashes_with_motorist_death:.3f}% in 2025 ({share_change_pct:.1f}% higher)."
            ),
            "interpretation": (
                f"The chart answers whether motorist-fatal crashes became less common among reported crashes: the share rose from "
                f"{first.pct_crashes_with_motorist_death:.3f}% in 2013 to {last.pct_crashes_with_motorist_death:.3f}% in 2025. "
                "This is a defensible crash-based comparison because its denominator is all reported crashes in each year, but it is not a per-mile risk measure. "
                f"It leaves deaths per mile unanswered because the file has no mileage measure; {omission}"
            ),
        },
    ]
}
(OUT / "options.json").write_text(json.dumps(options, indent=2) + "\n")

print(annual.to_string(index=False))
print(f"\nTotal rows: {total_rows}; excluded years: {excluded_detail}; unusable rows: {int(coverage['unusable'].sum())}")
print(f"Death count change: {death_change_pct:.6f}%; fatal-crash share change: {share_change_pct:.6f}%")
